Added 2026-08-23; reviewed and narrowed 2026-10-09. CVE-2020-27225 affects the Eclipse Help Subsystem's unauthenticated livehelp endpoint. The named runtime bundles contain no help web server or livehelp servlet. The selector excludes every org.eclipse.help bundle, including help.base, help.ui and help.webapp, so those components remain scanned.
Dependency-Check maps the independent bundle versions to the Eclipse Platform product version. No upgrade of these runtime bundles fixes that product mismatch. https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=569855

Added 2026-08-23. CVE-2014-125035 is cross-site scripting in a web application plugin named "jobs-plugin". It is matched here against org.eclipse.platform:org.eclipse.core.jobs, which is the Eclipse background-job scheduler and shares nothing with it but the word "jobs". The two are unrelated products, so no version of this package is affected and no upgrade applies. https://github.com/mrbobbybryant/Jobs-Plugin/pull/2
